failure.title: Isolated PostgreSQL integration databases lacked admin-installed pgvector
failure.note: The third cold Docker protocol passed QA-DKR-001 through QA-DKR-008, then retained a structured QA-DKR-009 failure when the isolated authoritative integration suite could not bootstrap vector in its temporary database.
failure.diagnosis: The harness created an isolated database owned by the application role, while pgvector was installed only in the main database during container initialization. The non-superuser application role correctly could not substitute for the administrative extension bootstrap.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
